rule: Count roman-numeral manufacturer/region families from the page's figure-guide text (I: Kader). A blank label takes the manufacturer on the next line (II: then Smile). Jawa's guide has no colons (I Kader). A repeated guide that starts again at I is one list; keep the longer labels. If that list is absent, count COO Family headings. Skip a label that starts with 'not'. IV.1 is a sub-point, not a family. Do not count paint, cape, sabre or mould-comparison sections. Stormtrooper's text index is I-VI; the COO sheet image adds VII: PBP/Lili Ledy. No list means unverified.
